scope: Selected data only. No source code, article text, figures, images, alignments, spreadsheets or complete upstream archives included. No runtime provider integration. Original software remains 0BSD; upstream data retain their own terms.
reproduction: tools/prepare-datasets.py takes locally supplied verified downloads; all five output hashes must match. audit.json contains original review descriptions and factual provenance.

files.changes: Removed NEXUS envelope around the single UTREE statement; retained all Newick labels, comments and length tokens, appended newline. UTREE token alone is not a biological root claim.
